components.connecting_argument: For one new vertex choose a nonzero residue class at each old prime giving its prescribed Legendre symbol. Combine these with the reduced class representing its type by CRT; the moduli are coprime after fixed support is separated. Dirichlet gives infinitely many primes in the resulting reduced class, so avoid all old and finitely excluded primes. Repeat for each new vertex and use reciprocity for reverse bits. The same construction realizes a permitted product-template type with all its external incidences. The separate graph-dependence theorem identifies the symbol values.

At r=1 there is no such bit. Repeated derivatives along the contraction forest give its unit terminal value, proving the original multilinear polynomial nonzero. Keep r-1 type anchors and merge the nonempty remainder: equality of total type forces the final seed type. Minimum-seed independence removes internal-bit choices. Addresses use only nonzero linear activations; formal bit variables do not alter the already fixed initial prime realization.

components.connecting_argument: Partitionability gives a nonzero stationary terminal polynomial. Build arbitrarily large cubes based at the unchanged d with unit symbols at all other addresses. Their scalar valuations have one fixed bound after the same denominator clearing. Fix precision above that bound and use a cube dimension larger than the sum of the bounded bit degrees. The Boolean comparison gives a nonzero address congruent to the base at that precision. A zero or larger-valuation base would force the same at this address, contradicting its unit bound. Use the central corank-zero comparison to obtain the stated normalized L-value bound. The required dimension may depend on d; C1 does not. Empty units use the direct coefficient bound instead.

components.connecting_argument: For an empty unit choose one actual stage with precision above delta_o: the D=1 coefficient is visible, so RC follows immediately. Otherwise fix the permitted unit k before b; its nonzero central value gives twist corank zero by the separate forward theorem. A fresh ramified prime of quadratic K is unramified in each old label normal closure and in Q(E[8]); hence K cannot lie in those fields and its intersection with each is Q. Old labels have lifts split in K. Stabilize the actual common alphabet on the same ultrafilter, retaining all relations and only separate projection surjectivity. Finally the restriction/corestriction sum-and-difference maps have kernels/cokernels killed by a fixed2-power; after tensoring compact Selmer modules with Q2 they give the plus/minus direct sum and add coranks. No integral direct sum or finite-Sha inference is made.
